def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    r, c = next((i, j) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if grid[i][j] == 3)

    length = 2

        dr, dc = dirs[leg % 4]
        for _ in range(length):
            if 0 <= r < n and 0 <= c < n and grid[r][c] != 2:
                out[r][c] = 3
            r += dr
            c += dc
        leg += 1
        if leg % 2 == 0:
            length += 2
    return out
